panels.title: Up
panels.description: 1 when the exporter can reach the database.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of reads served from memory. Below 99% means the working set no longer fits.

panels.title: Evicted keys
panels.description: Keys Redis threw away because memory was full. Should stay 0.

panels.title: Messages waiting
panels.description: Ready messages across all queues, not yet delivered to a consumer.

panels.title: Unacknowledged
panels.description: Delivered to a consumer but not yet acknowledged.

panels.title: Dead-lettered (1h)
panels.description: Messages moved to a dead-letter exchange in the last hour.

panels.title: Messages waiting by queue
panels.description: The ten fullest queues. Empty queues are hidden.

panels.title: Under-replicated
panels.description: Partitions missing an in-sync replica. Should be 0.

panels.title: Consumer lag
panels.description: Messages written but not yet read, across all consumer groups.

panels.title: Messages in / s by topic
panels.description: Topics with no traffic are hidden.

panels.title: Consumer lag by group
panels.description: Shows data once the API consumers have connected.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: 1 when Prometheus can reach the broker.

panels.title: Messages waiting
panels.description: Messages ready to deliver across all queues.

panels.title: Unacknowledged
panels.description: Delivered but not yet acknowledged by a consumer.

panels.title: Dead-lettered
panels.description: Messages sitting in dead-letter queues.

panels.title: Consumers
panels.description: Consumers attached across all queues.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open client connections.

panels.title: Messages waiting per queue
panels.description: The ten deepest queues. Empty queues are hidden.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: 1 when Prometheus can reach the Kafka exporter.

panels.title: Brokers
panels.description: Brokers the exporter can see.

panels.title: Topics
panels.description: Application topics (internal ones hidden).

panels.title: Under-replicated
panels.description: Partitions with fewer in-sync replicas than configured. Should be 0.

panels.title: Consumer lag
panels.description: Messages written but not yet read, across all consumer groups.

panels.title: Consumer groups
panels.description: Groups currently reading. 0 while the API is stopped.

panels.title: Messages written / s
panels.description: Write rate per topic.

panels.title: Consumer lag per group
panels.description: Rising lag means a consumer is falling behind.
